description: Angular component for dashboard settings dialog in Thingsboard UI, managing form controls, layout, and interactions.

classes.name: DashboardSettingsDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring dashboard settings, including form management, layout adjustments, and dialog interactions.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions when the component is destroyed.

methods.name: isScada
methods.description: Checks if the current layout type is SCADA.

methods.name: get isDefaultLayout
methods.description: Returns true if the layout type is default.

methods.name: get isDefaultBreakpoint
methods.description: Returns true if the breakpoint is default.

methods.name: isErrorState
methods.description: Determines if a form control is in an error state.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Collects form data, cleans it, and closes the dialog with the updated settings.

methods.name: getStatesControllerTranslation
methods.description: Returns translated label for a given state controller ID.

methods.name: updateGridSettingsFormState
methods.description: Updates the enabled/disabled state of grid settings form controls based on current layout and breakpoint.
